menu.credsets_hint: Special case - only if an administrator blocks the app
menu.yes_flag: --yes: ask nothing, take the defaults (for scripts)

setup.title: Setup
setup.need_code: Please paste the setup code you were given.
setup.code_is_secret: The code is like a password. Do not forward it by email.
setup.code_discarded: The code is not stored and is now used up.

add.title: Add an account
add.which_email: Which Google account should be connected?
add.duplicate: {email} is already connected. Nothing to do.
add.services_default: Default: Gmail, Drive and Calendar - all read-only.
add.type_unknown: The domain {domain} does not appear to be hosted at Google. Please check.
add.logout_first: Important: SIGN OUT of Google in your browser first.
add.logout_why: Otherwise the consent screen silently takes whichever account is currently signed in.
add.choose_account: Please pick {email} - use "Use another account" if needed.
add.unverified_warning: You will see "Google hasn't verified this app".
add.unverified_normal: That is expected here: continue via "Advanced" -> "Go to ...".
add.checking: Checking which account is actually connected ...
add.wrong_account_fix: Sign out of Google in the browser and try again.
add.no_identity: Sign-in completed, but no API responds.
add.service_fail: {service} does not respond - is the {api} enabled in the Cloud project?

list.title: Overview
list.not_verified: not yet checked after the deadline

verify.title: Check access
verify.no_access_why: Either not connected yet, or consent has expired.
verify.publishing_hint: Have the operator check: is the Cloud project set to "In production"?
verify.admin_hint: Or a Workspace administrator has blocked the app.

remove.title: Remove an account
remove.revoke_failed: Consent could not be revoked automatically.
remove.revoke_manual: Please revoke it by hand: https://myaccount.google.com/permissions

doctor.title: Check environment
doctor.node_old: Node.js {version} is too old. Version 20 or newer is required.
doctor.gws_install_manual: Please do it by hand: npm install -g @googleworkspace/cli
doctor.creds_missing: No credentials yet. Enter the setup code first.

credsets.title: Add your own Cloud project
credsets.when: Only needed if an administrator blocks the prepared app, or the user limit is reached.
credsets.how: How would you like to enter the credentials?
credsets.audience_prompt: Is the project Internal or External?
credsets.exists: Credentials with that identifier already exist.

stale.heading: Important: access not yet confirmed
stale.body: {count} account(s) were connected more than 7 days ago and have not been checked since.
stale.why: A misconfigured Cloud project cuts access off after exactly 7 days - silently. Only a check after that proves it holds.

err.node_too_old: Node.js 20 or newer is required. Found: {version}.
err.no_gws: The Google Workspace CLI (gws) is missing. Please run "Check environment".
err.no_credsets: No credentials stored yet. Please enter the setup code first.
err.bad_email: "{value}" does not look like an email address.
err.code_format: The code is not in the expected format. It starts with "GWSC1.".
err.code_checksum: The code is incomplete or altered - the checksum does not match. Please paste it again in full.
err.code_version: This code is for a different version of the tool.
err.code_client_id: The client ID in the code is implausible - it must end in .apps.googleusercontent.com.
